authority.statement: This record freezes local candidate artifacts only. It does not authorize transfer, configuration changes, service restart, proxy reload, or a public-success claim.

build.ldflags: -s -w -buildid= plus source commit, release and build time identity

monitorReleaseTree.format: deterministic GNU tar, source plus built dist, excludes node_modules and .env

monitor.requiredConnectivity: HTTP 200 application/json, cache-control no-store, not static HTML

mustCaptureBeforeMutation: sha256 and mode of current Explorer and Indexer binaries
resolved current Monitor release target and checksummed release tree
current Monitor ingress snippet and its sha256
current service states and version endpoint bodies
current environment file digests without recording secret contents
restoreOnAnyFailure: restore captured Explorer and Indexer binaries
restore the captured Monitor release target and ingress snippet
validate and reload only the scoped proxy configuration
restart only ynx-explorerd, ynx-indexerd and ynx-monitor
record the restored official version and connectivity hashes
failureTriggers: non-6423 native identity or non-0x1917 EVM identity
Monitor connectivity HTML fallback or non-JSON schema

requiredSingleUseLease.scope: only the three source-bound artifacts and the exact Monitor /connectivity matcher
mustBind: candidate source commit, tree and all three artifact hashes
fresh current runtime and rollback digests collected by the authorized production operator
named operator, expiry, receipt schema and rollback authority
post-deploy official-domain source, HTTP, JSON, transaction and visual verification
doesNotAuthorize: Chain Core, Faucet, Wallet, Finance or Data Fabric mutation
publicVerified or computerControlVerified promotion without direct evidence

localValidation.monitor: 50 Monitor tests plus 10 scripts and production build passed
localValidation.fullGoSuite: Explorer and Indexer passed; unrelated bftgateway and consensus tests require a missing devtools SampleEVMWriteCounter artifact and did not exercise this owner change
